zh: DragonClaw 问答接入表字典：用中文表名、近似说法或英文表名都能找到 NetCare / DataFab 业务表并直接查数。找表时会同时匹配表字典里的中文名、看板、说明和字段中文名，结果里标出 NetCare / DataFab / 二次加工；看字段时附带字段中文名。
新增「看板指标」查询工具：问到看板或看板上的指标（如「整改清零--整体网元进展」）时，直接读取按看板 SQL 算好的结果，源表变化后会自动重算。
en: DragonClaw chat now uses the table dictionary: Chinese table names, close phrasings and English names all find NetCare / DataFab tables and query them directly. Table search also matches dictionary names, boards, descriptions and field names, labels NetCare / DataFab / Reprocessed, and column details include Chinese field names.

New board-metrics tool: questions about a board or one of its metrics (e.g. a rectification board) read the results already computed from the board SQL, which recompute automatically when source tables change.
